summary: Merged 5 green PRs (feed-quality-gate #3, kinz-secure-commerce-hub #54, Next.js-SaaS #92/#93, kinz-accounting #22) and closed Next.js-SaaS #81 in favor of its fix. btc-llm-sentiment's default branch CI is red (missing 'requests' dep) and the existing fix PR #58 can't be auto-merged because it edits .github/workflows/ci.yml, which the merge rules categorically forbid — needs Nassim to merge it by hand. Left open and reported: 4 dependabot PRs in kinz-secure-commerce-hub and 2 in Next.js-SaaS (rebase already requested within 48h, or a genuine breaking API change in @ai-sdk/react needing owner review). All other repos (analytics-service-toolkit, kinz-competitor-intelligence, kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline, kinz-price-bridge) were already green with no open PRs and pull_request CI already configured.
